# nf-claw

> A self-maintaining, token-minimal library of nf-core Nextflow DSL2 pipelines curated for autonomous AI agents and bioinformaticians. Unmodified upstream releases are executed with deterministic preflight validation, strict identifier hygiene, cryptographic provenance bundles, reproducible replay guards, and multi-stage pipeline chaining.

nf-claw provides AI agents with structured, machine-actionable instructions and CLI tooling to discover, configure, execute, and chain production-grade nf-core bioinformatic pipelines without hallucinated parameters or manual wrapper overhead.

Key conventions for AI agents navigating this repository:
- Discover without token bloat: Do not read full catalogs or directory listings. Grep `catalog.json` (or `catalog.md`) for keywords.
- Inspect pipeline skills: Read `pipelines/<name>/skill.md` for required inputs, parameters, and verified run commands. Consult `pipelines/<name>/reference.md` for complete parameter constraints.
- Run safely: Execute with `nfclaw run <name> --input <file> --outdir <dir> -profile <profile>` (or `python3 -m runner run ...`). Pass `--check` for preflight schema validation and dry-run command inspection without execution.
- No samplesheet yet: pass the data files as `--input` (a directory, a quoted glob or several files) and nfclaw generates the samplesheet from the pipeline's own schema; set the columns no file name determines with `--sheet-set COLUMN=VALUE` (listed under Inputs in each `skill.md`).
- Check status: Monitor foreground or background runs with `nfclaw status <outdir>`. Runs are logged to `<outdir>/provenance/logs/run.log` and protected by a non-blocking writer lock beside the output directory (`.<outdir name>.nfclaw.lock`).
- Sample identity safety: Scientific metadata identifiers (`meta.id`, sample/patient IDs, genome/database names) must start with a letter, digit or underscore and contain only letters, digits, combining marks, dots, underscores or hyphens (Unicode letters and digits count). nfclaw refuses other identifiers rather than renaming samples. Local paths in samplesheets must always be absolute.
- Multi-stage chaining: Orchestrate sequential pipelines via declarative JSON specs with `nfclaw chain run <spec.json> --outdir <dir>`.
- Replay & verification: Reproduce runs into fresh targets using `<outdir>/provenance/commands.sh` and verify results with `nfclaw verify <target> --against <original>`.
- Operational manual: Read `AGENTS.md` before executing or chaining pipelines.

## Agent Guidance

- [Agent Operational Manual (AGENTS.md)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Authoritative operational rules for AI agents: CLI execution semantics, parameter preflight, samplesheet rules, identity safety, status inspection, locking, chaining, replay, and benign warning triage.
- [Claude Code Entry Point (CLAUDE.md)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): Dedicated entry point for Anthropic Claude Code (maintained in identical parity with AGENTS.md).

## Essential Documentation

- [Repository Overview & Quickstart (README.md)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/README.md): Repository layout, quickstart examples, provenance bundles, scientific validation notes, and citations.
- [System Architecture (docs/architecture.md)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): Four architectural zones, schema preflight gates, non-blocking sibling writer locks (`.nfclaw.lock`), and cryptographic provenance bundle structure.
- [Pipeline Chaining Engine (docs/chaining.md)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/docs/chaining.md): Multi-stage workflow orchestration, declarative JSON specs, cryptographic handoff verification, automated stage retries, and lineage tracking.
- [Engine Compatibility & Runtime Controls (docs/compatibility.md)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/docs/compatibility.md): Nextflow DSL2 compatibility, Nextflow engine version pinning (`--nxf-ver`), JVM tuning (`--nxf-env`), and host resource limit controls (`--limit-*`).
- [Known Issues & Operational Troubleshooting (docs/known-issues.md)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/docs/known-issues.md): Triage guide for benign upstream Nextflow warnings (e.g. nf-schema config scopes), host environment issues (IPv6, disk, permissions), and pipeline-specific workarounds.
- [Upstream Tracking & Maintenance Automation (docs/updating.md)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/docs/updating.md): Submodule version tracking, automated release bumping, schema drift auditing (`librarian.check_drift`), and zero-drift policy.

## Pipeline Catalogs & Library

- [Pipeline Catalog Markdown (catalog.md)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/catalog.md): Human-readable index of every tracked nf-core pipeline with its pinned version, declared input, output locations and description (use grep; do not read whole).
- [Pipeline Catalog JSON (catalog.json)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/catalog.json): Machine-readable catalog: for every tracked pipeline its name, pinned version, description, summary, declared input, output locations, tools and the pipelines it feeds (use grep; do not read whole).
- [Upstream Sources Manifest (sources.tsv)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/sources.tsv): Tab-separated registry mapping each pipeline to its upstream Git repository and tracking policy.
- [Pipeline Library Directory (pipelines/)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/tree/main/pipelines): Library of individual pipelines (`pipelines/<name>/`), each holding pinned code (`upstream/`), agent instructions (`skill.md`), and complete parameter schemas (`reference.md`).

## Optional

- [Contributing Guidelines (CONTRIBUTING.md)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Guide for contributing new pipelines, modifying librarian automation, and running tests.
- [Live Web Portal](https://danilomonge.github.io/nf-claw/): Interactive web portal for exploring pipelines, parameter schemas, live GitHub Actions workflows, and system architecture.
- [Academic Citation (CITATION.cff)](https://github.com/danilomonge/nf-claw/blob/main/CITATION.cff): Citation Metadata Format file for referencing nf-claw and wrapped nf-core pipelines.
